title: agropyron caninum subsp. biflorum
intro: Agropyron caninum subsp. biflorum, commonly known as a type of wild grass, is a plant species that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which help to reduce pain and swelling, and its antioxidant properties, which protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron caninum subsp. biflorum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
